description: This file defines the ControllerFactory class responsible for instantiating and setting up controller instances based on the module name in a SuiteCRM environment. The method getController dynamically loads the appropriate controller class, considering customizations, and returns an instance.

classes.name: ControllerFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create and return appropriate controller instances based on module name, considering customizations.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns an instance of the appropriate controller class for a given module, loading the class file as needed and considering custom controllers.
